description: Adult bear (much larger than the tree base) walks leftward across the foreground; a cub is held in its mouth in f14402-f14404 and is out of frame by f14405; legs cross in front of the trunk. Background (hills, conifers, tree) appears static in tiles.
Cub carried by the bear leaves the frame at upper left by f14405.
Skull-on-silhouette composition drifts rightward by a few tile pixels over f14455-f14459 and then holds; mechanism (pan vs element move) cannot be separated since sign appears nearly fixed.
Small label shorter nasal bones with arrow appears at left in f14462, absent f14455-f14461; appears small, size growth in later frames is not viewed.
Classroom framing enlarges (board, projector, lecturer larger) across f14697-f14704 with content drifting rightward; reads as push-in with lateral shift.
Chalk numeral 2 appears before options at f14698; f14697 shows only options.
Bear walks leftward toward the seated figure; head and legs step; tree and figure static.
Bear tone becomes darker (shaded) from about f14859 as it nears the tree; cause (shade layer vs retint) unknown.
Bear continues leftward, head lowering slightly and hind legs stepping; tree and figure unchanged.
Text card changes instantly from option 2 (f15134-15136) to you fight (f15137-15141); no fade visible at tile resolution.
Bear head enters at the right edge in f15247 and advances leftward, followed by body and shadow ellipse by f15253; figure stationary.
Figure, bear and trees all shift leftward in frame and bear enlarges over f15268-f15275, consistent with camera movement plus approach.
Lecturer's pointer lowers from chalk text height to a near horizontal position pointing left; head fairly steady.
Figure with extended right arm and closed eyes stays in place; no bear; no change at tile resolution.
Bear enters at the right in f15873; head and forepaw move left and downward toward the extended arm across f15873-f15880.
Lecturer's head dips and turns, shifting rightward and downward behind the podium; board text static.
Lecturer slides further rightward and down, partially leaving the frame behind the podium by f16219; native f16315 shows him absent.
